purpose: Compare broad semantic-relation types in source-attested historical X~X+ameke pairs and the corrected semantically transparent subset of modern exact X~X+ami pairs.
correction_note: Comíami is added after SRC-02 source-level evidence established Pp classification and an explicit 'pp: comíami' note.

state_or_property_to_property_or_holder: Igue → Igueameke: sehr → ein Starker, der Kräfte hat
Lessí → Lessíameke: ermatten, müde werden → müde, matt

excluded_modern_exact_pairs.reason: Only the 49 semantically transparent/source-supported exact pairs are admitted to this corrected functional matrix.

interpretation: Historical and modern transparent datasets independently contain event-to-agent/participant, state/property/result, and attributive relation types. The relative frequencies are not inferentially compared because the samples are lexicographic, small/unequal and not balanced. The evidential value is recurrence of relation types plus source-explicit analyses in individual cases.

epistemic_limits.relation_type_assignment: AI-assisted semantic coding from dictionary glosses, corrected when source-explicit annotations become available
